description: This file contains internal compatibility and schema handling code for FastAPI, including model field management, schema generation, and utility functions for Pydantic models.

classes.name: ModelField
classes.description: Represents a model field with validation and serialization capabilities, including validation, serialization, default value handling, and schema generation.

methods.name: asdict
methods.description: Converts a FieldInfo object into a dictionary of its attributes, annotations, and metadata.

methods.name: ModelField.__post_init__
methods.description: Initializes the ModelField, setting up the type adapter and handling warnings for Pydantic version compatibility.

methods.name: ModelField.get_default
methods.description: Returns the default value for the field, or Undefined if required.

methods.name: ModelField.validate
methods.description: Validates a value against the field's type, returning the validated value or errors.

methods.name: ModelField.serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value according to the field's type and serialization mode.

methods.name: get_schema_from_model_field
methods.description: Generates a JSON schema for a given ModelField, considering overrides and references.

methods.name: get_definitions
methods.description: Generates JSON schema definitions for a set of fields, including handling nested models and references.

methods.name: _replace_refs
methods.description: Recursively replaces $ref references in a schema with new references based on a mapping.

methods.name: _remap_definitions_and_field_mappings
methods.description: Remaps schema references and definitions based on a model name map.

methods.name: is_scalar_field
methods.description: Checks if a field is scalar based on its annotation.

methods.name: is_sequence_field
methods.description: Checks if a field is a sequence type.

methods.name: is_scalar_sequence_field
methods.description: Checks if a field is a scalar sequence.

methods.name: is_bytes_field
methods.description: Checks if a field is a bytes type.

methods.name: is_bytes_sequence_field
methods.description: Checks if a field is a bytes sequence.

methods.name: copy_field_info
methods.description: Creates a copy of FieldInfo with a new annotation.

methods.name: serialize_sequence_value
methods.description: Serializes a sequence value based on its type.

methods.name: get_missing_field_error
methods.description: Returns a validation error indicating a missing required field.

methods.name: create_body_model
methods.description: Creates a Pydantic model class for a set of fields.

methods.name: get_model_fields
methods.description: Extracts ModelField objects from a Pydantic model class.

methods.name: get_cached_model_fields
methods.description: Returns cached ModelField list for a model class.

methods.name: get_model_name_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from model names to model classes, normalizing names.

methods.name: get_compat_model_name_map
methods.description: Creates a model name map suitable for compatibility between Pydantic versions.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_model
methods.description: Retrieves all nested models from a given model.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_annotation
methods.description: Recursively extracts models from type annotations.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_field
methods.description: Extracts models from a ModelField.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_fields
methods.description: Extracts models from a list of ModelFields.

methods.name: _regenerate_error_with_loc
methods.description: Adjusts error locations by prefixing with a given path.
